top_choice_rationale: P003 is the one proposal in which a prediction (flat bands at a magic angle, 2011) and an observation (correlated insulating and superconducting states at that angle, 2018) each map onto identifiable originators, followed by broad independent replication in twisted multilayers and other moire systems. The discovery of the correlated states stands whatever the pairing mechanism proves to be, and the citation can be written around the prediction and the observation rather than a leadership role. The omission of Cao and Dean is a real cost the three-name limit cannot repair, and eight years is short, but waiting would not fix the credit. P005 is the most mature fallback with the cleanest experimental allocation; P004 mixes in Zoller and drops Esslinger; P001 has clean credit but reads as a measurement advance; P002 has the strongest science but no defensible three-name allocation across two collaborations.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; no documented link to MacDonald, Bistritzer, Jarillo-Herrero or the other credited names. Goran Johansson is a Chalmers colleague, but his main interest is circuit QED, which is not on this slate.
